about: Basketball's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L1): a sport's standard scoring, categories, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Basketball's (src/lib/sports/basketball.ts); slots take its positions or position groups (a box score says G, F or C, a roster PG, SG, SF, PF or C, so a guard's slot takes G too). The specs are in the game spec's shape (A1's schema, on the engine branch); slots and categories aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

categories.source: Yahoo's standard 9 categories (rotisserie and head-to-head categories)

season.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head each week.

short.about: One game, a series or a team's next few: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.

pickem.about: Each game, before it starts: who wins? A point for each one right, most points wins (a tie counts for nobody).

pickAFew.about: Each game, before it starts: pick three players. 3 points for each one who has the most points in the game (tied, each of them), most points wins.

ask.ask: Pick three: who has the most points?

categories.about: A season-long league by categories: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head in Yahoo's nine categories: each category you win is a win.

roto.about: A season-long league, roto-style: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup; each of Yahoo's nine categories ranks everyone over the season, points by rank, most points wins.

bestBall.about: Best ball: draft a full roster and never set a lineup: each game, your best ten count, most points wins.

squares.about: Squares on each game: take squares on a 10-by-10 grid of the two scores' last digits, the digits drawn at random once everyone has theirs. The square of the score wins a point at the end of each of the first three quarters and two for the final score, most points wins.
